citation: i2spec, Phase C: B MLR fitted to measured B levels with X held at mlr_x_2026b (2026-09-18). Not a published parameter set.
fitted_to: 787 B levels implied by every 127I2 absolute frequency with v'' <= 17 (X level from mlr_x_2026b, hyperfine offset frozen) at hypot(sigma_obs, 1 MHz); the published B levels for v' <= 30 at 3 MHz as shape guidance; the 15 atlas bands above v' = 44 at 0.005 cm-1. C5, C6, C8, C10 carry their published priors; Te + De is tied to De(X) + 7602.9762 cm-1. Result: measured levels 1.7 MHz rms at v' <= 30, 6.7 at 31-44, 17 at 45-50; atlas 0.029 cm-1. prototypes/mlr_b_levels.py.
born_oppenheimer: taken from i2spec2026a B (alpha and V_ad, including the V_ad constant)
status: research result; the shipped model still uses i2spec2026a. With mlr_x_2026b it matches the published model on the precision sets to within about 2x and beats it by 10^2-10^4 above v' = 44 and v'' = 47; the BIPM 532 nm inter-line intervals regress from 3.9 to 26.6 MHz because intervals were not among the fitted levels.
